data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: The original file has Slurm directives but no shebang; treat it as a batch file.
# Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --nodes=32
#   --ntasks-per-node=1
#   --cpus-per-task=128
#   --output=out
#   --error=err
#   --time=06:00:00
#   --partition=gpus
#   --gres=gpu:1

#flux: -N 32
#flux: -n 32
#flux: -c 128
#flux: --time-limit=6h
#flux: --output=out
#flux: --error=err

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without GPUs (or fewer than 32 GPUs total), causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=gpus
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on non-GPU nodes or have different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm option: --ntasks-per-node=1 (explicit per-node placement)
# Flux does not have a universally portable batch directive for tasks-per-node; here -N 32 and -n 32 implies 1 per node on most systems.
# Performance implication: if task placement differs, performance may change.

source ~/pyenv
ml purge
ml Stages/Devel-2019a
ml GCC/8.3.0
ml ParaStationMPI/5.4.4-1
ml CUDA/10.1.105
ml NCCL/2.4.6-1-CUDA-10.1.105
ml cuDNN/7.5.1.10-CUDA-10.1.105

export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export NCCL_IB_CUDA_SUPPORT=0
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1

# Slurm used srun; under Flux, use flux-run to launch 32 ranks.
flux run -n 32 -c 128 python train_alae.py --config-file configs/imagenet.yaml

reasons: The original Slurm job required GPUs (`--gres=gpu:1` with 32 nodes implies 32 GPUs total) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this may allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run much slower.

The original Slurm job specified a GPU partition (`--partition=gpus`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
